site.sitedescription: The vegetation is dominated by forests of Pinus sylvestris, with Fagus sylvatica on the north facing slopes. Erica arborea forms the dominant shrub layer, with Vaccinium myrtillus, Erica australis and Pteridium aquilinum. Betula pendula is comon along streams, in flushes and wet hollows.
